top_story: Israel’s 24 November strike in Gaza that killed a UN worker and two others underscores that the October 2025 ceasefire has collapsed into a nominal framework, with at least 1,679 Palestinians killed since then and civilian protection mechanisms steadily eroded. This sustained violence is reshaping daily life in Gaza through attrition, displacement, and the degradation of already thin humanitarian channels. Outside the war zone, Amazon’s $7.5 billion acquisition of Israeli AI startup Decart’s technology and staff highlights how Israel’s high-end tech economy continues to draw global capital despite the conflict’s reputational and political costs. The near-simultaneous U.S. conviction of Huawei over Iran-related business signals a harsher enforcement climate around sanctions and strategic technology, tightening the regional environment in which commerce, war, and geopolitical alignment increasingly reinforce one another.
